blurb: Guests stay in secluded cottages with full kitchens and wood burning stoves, or suites with oceanfront views. The resort offers a family-oriented campground, a full-service marina, kayak and paddleboard rentals, and a meeting room for groups. Activities include kayaking, hiking, fishing, and exploring local galleries and beaches.

quotes.text: We rented out the common space and the whole campground for the weekend, as well as all the cabins. Gloria and Ken were very easy going yet professional hosts and helped us answer all the details we needed in advance to plan our 'hippie themed' wedding weekend. The spot was absolutely perfect for us - space to go be by oneself, space to play games with friends & kids, space to have a lovely ceremony in the orchard, and close to great pubs, stores, beaches, galleries and more.

We have stayed here several times but this was our first time tenting it. The bathrooms were spotless and the campground was well maintained and very family friendly. A lovely shared bbque to use and if you really needed a personal one they also had those you could request. As always Ken and Gloria are awesome hosts. You must check out the book store and if you run out of basic supplies they have a small store .

Wish We'd Booked another night! Rented a One Bedroom Cottage for two nights and really enjoyed ourselves. Kitchen was well stocked, view was lovely and the peace and quiet was wonderful. We don't normally travel with our dog but decided to bring her along as the resort is very dog friendly. The large deck was enjoyed by dog and humans alike.

Great getaway! The location of Page’s Resort and Marina is beautiful and peaceful. The cabin was overlooking Silva Bay and we had a view from every room. It was well stocked with all the necessities and so it was easy to feel right at home.

Friendly and informed staff greeted us at the dockside. Office has fabulous books, a few essential fresh baked goods and ice cream, not to mention a small freezer with a good stock of frozen meat and fish.
